verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service with a customer portal, so programmatic, scoped API credentials for an agent are a plausible capability to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence shows any API, token issuance, or permission scoping, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. Integrations with Bill.com, Stripe and Gusto are inbound data connections, not credentials a user can issue to an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
